summary: Adjust for the paint layer. Split out of MPI-368 planning: the outline story lives here, off the existing _morph primitive, which is why Shapes ships filled-only. Sits in the MPI-424 umbrella after MPI-373.

Filed under the MPI-440 canvas-family umbrella #2 (mask and paint parity). Order, standing constraints and the shared alpha-vs-luminance decision are in tasks/MPI-440/brief.md - read it before starting this card.

Picked up as the next MPI-440 member - MPI-441 unblocked it. NOTE the card text is STALE: it specs MaskManager._morph, which MPI-441 deleted; the shared primitive is now managers/distanceField.js and the reuse is the same, one module.

BUILT, maturity validating. 417/417 node tests (9 new in tests/paint-adjust.test.cjs), eslint 0 errors, and a 28/28 Chromium pixel probe on a two-colour square: shrink keeps every survivor RED/BLUE, grow lands the GREEN ring at x=40 with the original red intact at x=50, the 5/5 band spans exactly 45-54 with the interior empty, and a 20 image-px grow on an 8192 source moves the edge 10 LAYER px. Cost 2048=247ms then 7ms, 4096=1563ms then 64ms - the 4K row is a named, unfixed ceiling. Answers the MPI-440 alpha question: the shape of the paint layer is its ALPHA at >=128, and a created boundary is hard while untouched pixels keep their own colour and alpha. Outstanding: the users in-app pass.
